pulmonary vasoconstrictive responses to various vasoactive agents in rats are modulated by systemic vasoconstrictions.

the pulmonary vasculatures and airways of in vivo rats are not as sensitive to vasoconstriction as those of isolated perfused lungs, and the responses to vasoconstritors are modulated by systemic circulation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the responses of the pulmonary circulation and airway to different vasoconstrictive agonists are different.
